proximityInsight.exampleText: Eg: a top-ranked day on 27-Aug-15 landed within 3 days of a sharp fall on 24-Aug-15

bestDays.headlineSummary: If you missed the 15 best days in the analysis period, your portfolio lost a large share of its value compared to staying fully invested.

missingBestQuarter.headline: Returns lost from missing the best quarter over the latest three-year window was ~9% annualized

volatility.headline: Medium risk with 14.8% annualised volatility; typical daily move ±0.66%

summary.headline: 14 of 14 calendar years (100%) printed a new all-time high NAV — growth naturally spends much of its time at fresh peaks.

postAthReturns.headline: The average 1-year return from investing in Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth on an all-time high day is ~24%.

athDeclineOutlook.headline: In 76% of instances where Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth reached an all-time high, it never fell 10% below that level — further declines came from much higher levels.
